newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: One killed, four wounded in explosion in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: One killed, four wounded in explosion in Karachi.

text.p: An explosion rocked Pakistan's troubled port city of Karachi on Monday, killing one man and wounding four people, including three children, police said.
They said the blast had occurred in the central Liaquatabad area, a stronghold of the ethnic Mohajir National Movement (MQM). The cause of the explosion was not immediately clear.
"A 22-year-old man was killed, while three children and a woman were wounded in the blast," a police officer said.
The explosion damaged a single-storey building that was still under construction. No other details were available.
